messages:
incident-bot: CRITICAL alert — GPU pool 'prod-gpu-usw2' at 98% alloc, queue growth > 1.2k. Autoscaler failing to add nodes. Paging oncall.
maria (oncall): acked — looking now. any customer-facing impact? :eyes:
customer-bridge-bot: 3 customer clusters reporting inference timeouts, some 503s. Top impacted: billing-service (high QPS), realtime-chat (spike).
raj (infra): same. CA logs show repeated launch failures from ASG creation path. probable IAM/launchtemplate rejection.
taylor (serving): we're seeing tokenized request backlog increasing, p95 latency spiking 6x. Can we route to cpu fallback? jen (sre): routing would blow cost but reduce errors. we should mitigate immediate customer impact first.
maria (oncall): raj, paste the autoscaler error lines from controller logs.
raj (infra): here are the recent CA errors:
```
E0323 10:14:01.123456 1 scale_up.go:412] Failed to scale up: failed to launch: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/prod-gpu-node-role
	status code: 403, request id: abcdef-1234
E0323 10:14:03.654321 1 cloud_provider.go:289] Launch template validation failed: launch template version 3 is missing required tag "redwood:pool". rejecting
```
raj (infra): also a couple of ASG throttles: `Throttling: Rate exceeded` when creating InstanceProfile attachments.
jen (sre): two different failure modes — IAM PassRole denied + launch template/tag validation. both blocking nodegroup creation.
maria (oncall): timeline: queue started growing ~10:09 (QPS spike), autoscaler attempted scale at 10:12, repeated failures since 10:12. impact: degraded throughput and 5-10% 5xx across inference paths.
taylor (serving): Can we hotfix by creating nodes manually in the pool (use existing LT/version) and then force register? that buys time.
raj (infra): I can manually create an ASG with LT version 2 (known-good) and attach correct instance profile. but IAM PassRole still needs fix — likely new deploy tightened role trust. I'll try attaching via infra CLI.
jen (sre): I'll open a short mitigation runbook: 1) create manual nodegroup with existing LT v2 2) label/taint to accept GPU workloads 3) cordon some low-priority pods to free GPU slots 4) temporarily relax routing fallback to cpu-pool for non-urgent tenants.
maria (oncall): start manual creation, raj — run with `--dry-run` first then create. keep me posted. taylor, start routing rules to reduce load on GPU pool for low-priority requests.
taylor (serving): starting route change: setting feature-flag `gpu_only=false` for billing-service for the next 15m. patching canary now. ETA 3m.
raj (infra): manual ASG creation output (snip):
```
$ infra asg create --name prod-gpu-temp-230323 --lt-version 2 --instance-profile prod-gpu-profile
ASG created: prod-gpu-temp-230323 (3 instances initializing)
Warning: InstanceProfile attach rate limit, retrying...
```
raj (infra): attaching instance profile succeeded on retry. nodes booting and joining kube.
jen (sre): I'm adding a temporary suppress for escalation alerts on this thread and note in postmortem channel.
maria (oncall): customer-bridge, update: creating manual nodes & partial routing fallback. expect decreased 5xx for most customers in ~10m. Continue collecting impacted customer list.
customer-bridge-bot: Noted. Billing-service errors down from 9% -> 2% in last 7m. Realtime-chat still at 6% but trending down.
taylor (serving): can we avoid full node churn? please ensure new nodes use LT v2 so no taint drift.
raj (infra): confirmed new nodes joined with label gpu=true and taint gpu=reserved:NoSchedule set to allow control. applying tolerations for serving pool.
jen (sre): monitoring: queue length decreased from 1.2k -> 300 in 12m. p95 latency down to 1.6x baseline.
maria (oncall): next steps: (1) infra to fix IAM PassRole policy (likely missing `iam:PassRole` for autoscaler role) — raj to own (2) validate launch template tags and automate tag check in CI — raj + infra infra
(3) add CA guardrails: failover to manual creation after 2 failed attempts — ops task (jen)
(4) post-incident customer summary and RCA due EOD — maria to coordinate with customer-bridge.
raj (infra): creating iam ticket, putting immediate policy change behind emergency change. will coordinate with security.
maria (oncall): thanks everyone. keep updates in this thread only. I'll escalate to leadership if anything regresses. closing paging loop in 30m if stable. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by maria; paging will remain open until manual close."
